description.html: The advantage of an artificial plant is that it looks the same day after day: it does not rot, lose leaves or need strong lighting or fertilizer. It does not affect water parameters, and fish use it as cover, especially younger and shyer ones.
The photo is for illustration only: shape and color depend on current stock, so call us and we will send you photos of the models available. If you need a different height, we also have 10 cm plants.

At 20 cm high, it suits the middle of the aquarium best: tall enough to fill the space between low plants in front and tall ones by the back glass, and in smaller tanks it can also go at the back. When algae appear on the leaves, take the plant out, rinse it under lukewarm water and brush it with a soft brush. Do not use chemical cleaners, as residues can end up in the water.
